name: MarkdownMessage
description: Markdown renderer that maps elements onto design-system components so chat replies and long-form content share one typographic path.

a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Promoted from alpha: Example + ForcedColors stories present; Storybook axe gate enabled.

content.description: Markdown source rendered through DS typography.

fallback.description: Plain text shown when content is empty or fails to parse.

renderWithDesignSystem.description:
Render markdown using the design system components (Title/Text/Link).
Useful for long-form content pages to ensure consistent styling.

designSystemTextSize.description:
When `renderWithDesignSystem` is enabled, use this as the base size for
paragraph and inline emphasis text (e.g. `p`, `strong`, `em`).

density.description: Compact typography for in-chat assistant replies.

forbiddenUse: Bypass design tokens or skip forced-colors verification at beta.
dense: Renders markdown through DS components (Title/Text/Link/CodeSnippet) — chat replies + long-form content share one styling path

usage.description: Markdown renderer that maps elements onto design-system components (Title, Text, Link, code blocks), so chat replies and long-form content share one typographic path.
